name: arc-hollow-frame-parity-fill
description: Use when an ARC grid contains hollow rectangular frames. Fill frame interiors based on the frame's side-length parity.

# ARC hollow-frame parity fill

Use when a puzzle shows disconnected, axis-aligned hollow rectangular outlines and demonstrations show their interiors being filled.

## Procedure
1. Identify each closed one-cell-thick rectangular outline, preserving its border and all background cells.
2. Measure the outline's outer width and height. Demonstrations can establish that interior fill depends on side-length parity: odd-sided frames are filled with color 7; even-sided frames with color 2. For rectangles, check the demos' convention if width and height parity differ; do not assume it without evidence.
3. Fill only the enclosed interior cells, leaving the border unchanged.
4. Check every frame and ensure output dimensions and all unrelated cells remain unchanged.

## Evidence / caveat
In the observed task family, square frames with odd side lengths (3, 5, 7) had interiors filled with 7, while even side lengths (4, 8) had interiors filled with 2. Confirm the mapping against any available demos before applying to a new task; this is a learned pattern, not a universal ARC rule.",
